description:
Your published and scheduled posts. list: the recent posts with their status and links. get: one post by slot id or generation id, with its publish results.
Actions and their required fields: list (no required fields); get (id).

action.description: What to do: list | get. The description lists the fields each action needs.

from.description: Range mode (with to): start of the window, inclusive. Returns every post of any status with slot_at in [from, to) as a single slots list, plus truncated=true when the cap was hit. At most 62 days.

id.description: A post id of either kind: a slot id (slotId from posts (action: list) / generate_video) or a generation id (generationId from video_tasks (action: list_generations)). The server resolves which one it is.

limit.description: Max number of upcoming and past posts to return (each list). Default 20, max 500. Ignored when from/to are given.

to.description: Range mode (with from): end of the window, exclusive.

name: posts
